prompt: The image is rendered in the style of a pencil sketch with light color wash, depicting the bustling interior of a fire station. On the left side, a tall firefighter in a yellow helmet stands firmly, holding a coiled hose that rests next to a shiny red engine. Beside him, a small boy in a blue cap looks up at the firefighter with wide eyes, while the firefighter points toward the ceiling. In the center, a woman in a green apron sits on a wooden bench, handing a steaming mug to a man in a gray suit who leans forward eagerly. Next to the bench, a black cat sleeps peacefully on a folded blanket, its tail curled tightly around its body. To the right, a dalmatian dog stands alert, looking at a hanging boot that dangles from a metal rack above. A young girl in a pink dress reaches up, trying to touch the dangling boot, while an older man in a brown coat watches her with a gentle smile. Behind them, a large clock on the wall shows the time, positioned above a row of lockers. A firefighter in orange gear polishes a brass bell, his reflection visible in the shiny surface. Nearby, a stack of newspapers lies on a table, slightly crumpled at the edges. A parrot in a cage chirps loudly, perched on a swing inside the wire enclosure. The floor is scattered with tools, including a wrench and a hammer, lying close to each other. There is no smoke filling the air, and there is no fire burning anywhere in the scene. The sketch lines are loose yet precise, capturing the casual atmosphere of the station. The light color wash adds subtle warmth to the reds and yellows, enhancing the visual depth without overpowering the pencil work.
